import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a count plot of the most common dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
sns.countplot(data=df[df['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)], y='Rasse1Text', order=top_breeds, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Registered Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
